candidates.description: This feature vector represents concepts related to autonomous machines, robotics, and artificial entities.
This vector activates for tokens related to the verb "to use" across multiple languages.
This vector represents descriptive adjectives and adverbs that modify nouns or indicate scale, certainty, and similarity.
This feature activates for plural and singular nouns denoting organized methods, structures, or operational processes.
These tokens represent modal verbs expressing possibility, ability, or necessity across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents quantifying determiners and pronouns indicating indefinite quantity across multiple European languages.
This feature vector represents the concept of capacity, capability, and potential (along with their opposites and linguistic variations).
This vector represents the concept of labor, employment, and the act of working across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents computing, digital technology, and electronic hardware.
This feature vector activates on words related to oversight, danger, aftermath, and words sharing the "super-" or "reperc-" prefix.
